summary:
Implementation plan for:
1. Interactive Mock Test Simulator & NCERT Question Bank Practice with timed CBT exam UI, question status palette, instant solution explanations, and XP scoring.
2. Formula Flashcard Deck with 3D flip animations, spaced repetition self-rating, and custom card creation.
3. Print-friendly PDF / study handout export and complete JSON data backup/restore.
4. Seamless dashboard integration with mobile-optimized layout.
